PendingBackgroundTerminal.description: A live background terminal whose exit Codex will still report.

notifyOnExit.description: `notify_on_exit` is on: the terminal is awaited until it exits, not only while its output watch expects news.

outputWatch.description: The pattern of the terminal's output watch, if one is on.

outputWatchMatched.description: The output watch matched (or took over from a watch that did), so it is awaited only while matching lines keep coming.

outputWatchWaitMs.description: How much longer, in milliseconds, the output watch keeps the terminal awaited without news: until its first matching line or, after one, until it goes quiet. Absent without a watch that is still awaited.

description: What a loaded thread still owes the model from background terminals.

activeTurnId.description: The turn running on the thread, if any.

notificationQueued.description: A queued background notification will start a turn of the thread.

terminals.description: Live terminals whose exit Codex will still report, by session ID.

turnStarting.description: A turn for pending work was reserved and is about to start.
